name: mtive-web
description: MTIVE Industries site (PANOPTES). Static files; the build copies them and the fonts already in public/ into dist/.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist/fonts dist/assets dist/video && cp index.html favicon.svg banner.svg bundle.js dist/ && cp public/fonts/BigShoulders_60pt-Medium.ttf public/fonts/BigShoulders_60pt-SemiBold.ttf public/fonts/BigShoulders_60pt-Bold.ttf public/fonts/BigShoulders_60pt-ExtraBold.ttf public/fonts/BigShoulders-Regular.ttf public/fonts/BigShoulders-Medium.ttf dist/fonts/ && cp public/assets/halftone-background.jpg dist/assets/ && cp public/video/prison_pan.mp4 public/video/prison_eye.mp4 dist/video/
